name: logosai-acp
description: LogosAI ACP agents as tools in Claude Code — connects through the `logosai mcp` stdio bridge.

logosai_bin.title: logosai executable
logosai_bin.description: Full path to the logosai command (e.g. /path/to/venv/bin/logosai). Use 'logosai' only if it is on PATH. Install with: pip install logosai

acp_url.title: ACP server URL
acp_url.description: Base URL of the ACP server (logosai serve defaults to http://localhost:9000)

agents.title: Allowed agents
agents.description: Comma-separated agent ids Claude may call. Leave out agents that touch files, mail or the desktop unless you mean to allow that.
